Subtracting 359 days from 1243-01-19:  
1243 is a common year (not divisible by 4 in Julian calendar rules for that era).  
359 days back from Jan 19: go to 1242-12-31 (19 days back), then 340 more days back into 1242.  
340 days before 1242-12-31 = 1242-01-25 (since Jan has 31 days, 340 = 365 - 25, so 25 days before end of year = Jan 25).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1242-01-25
